column1: # The ledger of spec/ (sketch/DEFINITION.0.md, section 5): one row per
# generated row (test/spec/def-fragment.tsv and the fragments beside it) the
# ports do not answer as the definition does, the answer each side gives,
# which side moves, both where the ruled answer is neither side's, and the
# cause. Both ports answer every listed case alike.
# A listed case that comes to agree fails the run. Bounded at 16.
